A great Western dragon erupts from the summoned portal, four legs and wings unfurling, roaring into being amid the arcane fire.
A rival caster on the far side hurls a blazing counter-spell, the two torrents of power colliding in a blinding clash.
Tiny robed onlookers flee the blast in the foreground, dwarfed and silhouetted against the wall of unleashed light.
A creature half-formed in the churning energy writhes at the spell's edge, one clawed limb fully solid, the rest dissolving into light.
The caster's familiar, a sleek silver fox, crouches at their heel, fur crackling with reflected magic, eyes wide and fierce.
Shattered stone debris hangs frozen mid-air around the caster, each fragment glowing at its edges where the spell's force arrested it.
A second figure behind the caster throws both arms across their face, robes whipping violently in the magical shockwave pouring outward.
Luminous spirits stream from the widening rift, trailing long ghost-light tails, rising fast as the spell tears the boundary open.
The ground beneath the caster splits in jagged fractures, pale blue energy bleeding upward through every crack like veins of living light.
A distant kingdom's skyline ignites on the horizon, towers and spires silhouetted against the enormous glow the spell throws across the sky.
An ancient artifact clutched in the caster's off hand pulses furiously, its carved runes blazing white as it feeds the growing spell.
A second dragon, midnight black, circles high above the portal's rim, wings beating slow, watching the summoning below with cold amber eyes.
A lone knight stands unmoving before the blast, visor down, gauntlet raised, the spell's light fracturing across their battered armor in shards.
Burning scrolls spiral outward from the caster's satchel, their inked runes lifting free as living fire before the wind scatters them gone.
A hooded figure in the crowd grabs a child and runs, the child's small hand tight-clasped, both swallowed by the fleeing mass.
A stone gargoyle on a nearby parapet cracks and animates, pulling free of its perch as the spell's raw energy jolts it alive.
Chains of crackling lightning arc between floating platform shards above the caster, connecting them like a constellation born from the overloaded spell.
A rival's summoned serpent coils at the portal's base, scales flashing every color as it absorbs the competing magic pouring into it.
A fallen tower bell hangs weightless in the spell's updraft, spinning slowly, its bronze face reflecting the full chaos of the scene.
Two apprentices grip each other at the edge of the blast radius, mouths open in awe, hair and robes pressed flat by the wind.
A crow familiar rides the magical shockwave overhead, feathers splayed, screaming into the gale, holding perfect position on the surging thermal.
A second caster kneels at a chalk circle nearby, feeding power into the primary spell through a glowing tether of woven light.
A massive stone door at the arena's far end buckles outward, its iron hinges exploding free as the spell's pressure wave reaches it.
Ghostly ancestor figures materialize in the smoke above the rift, faces solemn and vast, bearing witness as the great working tears reality open.
A dragon hatchling perches on the caster's pauldron, tiny wings fanned wide, adding its own small roar to the thunder of the spell.
